qualityDecision.reason: Blender front, rear and side previews show one complete GT with four wheels; no duplicate car or independent ground slab
qualityDecision.rawMaterialNeeds: Glass, tires and painted body share one opaque UV material and require semantic separation

vehicleFrame.toGameForwardPositiveZ: rotate +90 degrees about Y; game X=raw Z, game Z=-raw X

wheelEstimates.method: longitudinal peaks of lower neutral-color side faces; lower tire silhouette circle fit; lateral centre estimated from sidewall span
wheelEstimates.caveat: Generated tires are not perfectly circular. Negative-Z front lower profile is distorted; use final extracted wheel bounds to verify lateral centers rather than treating these estimates as exact axle pivots.
